notes:
Primary contact: CTO (Jonah Reed). Use case: fast, accurate search over multi-year broadcast and podcast transcripts + scanned program notes. Key constraints: 1) retain transcripts in US-only regions; 2) SSO + audit logs; 3) p95 end-to-end query latency target ~<400ms for surface apps. Cost sensitivity: wants estimated < $0.05/query at current query mix (heavy rerank on headline queries).

POC highlights (notes from internal):
- Ingest: 4.2M raw docs -> ~22M semantic chunks (avg 1.2k words/doc, chunk to ~512 tokens w/128-token overlap for transcripts; longer PDFs use heading-aware segmentation).
- Retrieval pipeline: sparse (BM25) + bi-encoder ANN -> 100 candidate limit -> cross-encoder reranker on top 10. They prefer hybrid to control recall while bounding reranker cost.
- Models tested: open bi-encoder 1536-d embeddings; cross-encoder distilled transformer (INT8 quantized) for rerank. POC ran with Redwood-hosted medium GPU; reranker p95 = 230ms for 10 candidates; ANN retrieval p95 = 80ms. End-to-end p95 ~320ms.
- Cost model: with dedicated infra and quantized reranker, projected compute cost ~$0.018/query (compute only) at their 10k qps-month equivalent; safety margin to $0.03 with networking/storage.
- Chunking experiments: semantic splitting by timecode +/- speaker change gave better fidelity on Q/A than fixed-length only; but fixed-length with overlap had more predictable index size. Proposal: mixed heuristic: semantic-first for transcripts, fixed+overlap for OCRed PDFs.
- Ingestion cadence: nightly batch for new broadcasts (~3 TB/night), incremental near-RT for breaking content (sub-5min lag). Concern: embedding refresh window and index re-shard impact during nightly loads.

technical_summary: Large-scale RAG for media archives. Current POC indexed ~22M chunks from 4.2M source docs. Pipeline = BM25 -> bi-encoder ANN (1536-d) -> cross-encoder reranker (top-k = 10). Chunking strategy: hybrid semantic segmentation for transcripts, fixed 512-token chunks with 128-token overlap for OCRed PDFs; store timecodes and speaker tags to improve reranker context. Reranker tuning: candidate pool sizing experiments (50/100/200) show diminishing returns after 100; recommended dynamic candidate cap based on query type. Latency target p95 <400ms achieved in POC with dedicated nodes and INT8 quantized reranker. Cost optimizations: quantized cross-encoder, selective rerank (only for queries with high intent probability), caching hot queries, and batched embedding compute during nightly ingest. Ingestion cadence and index refresh method remain open items for SRE integration.
